semantic_rule: Context highlights are explanatory only and are not causal diagnoses.
rainfall_threshold_basis: AOI-relative quantiles across 12 unique CHIRPS coarse contexts; not sample-weighted.
global_product_warnings: CHIRPS rainfall context has an effective spatial resolution of approximately 5.6 km and must not be interpreted as 10 m plantation information.
ERA5-Land and ET/PET context have an effective spatial resolution of approximately 11 km and are regional contextual information only.
Context reason codes represent contextual highlights and must not be interpreted as causal diagnoses of plantation stress, disease, nutrient deficiency, or management failure.
The production CONDITION_CLASS and RISK_SCORE_0_100 remain sourced from frozen 30D04 and are not modified by the contextual framework in Version 1.
